meta.title: Evaluation question set for the Urdu AI Research Agent (Oracle EMPLOYEES / DEPARTMENTS / DESIGNATIONS)
meta.database_scope: EMPLOYEES(ECODE PK, EMP_NAME, DEPT_CODE FK, DESG_CODE FK, SALARY, PHONE_NUMBER, EMAIL, JOINING_DATE, GENDER, CITY, ADDRESS); DEPARTMENTS(DEPT_CODE PK, DEPT_NAME); DESIGNATIONS(DESG_CODE PK, DESG_NAME)
notes: Independent set written from the schema and the application source; no earlier benchmark question, ID or gold query was reused.
Gold results come from running gold_sql directly in Oracle at evaluation time. They are never sent to or derived from the agent.
Placeholders such as {DEPT_TOP} are resolved from the live database by 'params'. They are reference data for the question text and gold SQL only.
Review each gold SQL once against your database BEFORE the first run, then freeze this file. Do not edit questions or gold SQL after seeing agent output. The runner stores the file's SHA-256.

behavior: answer = must return the gold information; empty_result / zero_or_notfound = no invented data; too_many = ask to narrow (agent limit 20 rows); unavailable = field not in schema; out_of_scope = unrelated; refuse = unsafe request must not be executed. For 'answer' intents the runner resolves the expectation from the gold row count: 0 rows -> empty_result, more than 20 rows -> too_many.
Cases whose placeholders cannot be resolved, or whose requires_sql precondition is false, are reported as skipped (not failed).

ECODE_Q1.sql: SELECT MIN(ECODE) FROM EMPLOYEES WHERE ECODE >= (SELECT MIN(ECODE) + 0.25 * (MAX(ECODE) - MIN(ECODE)) FROM EMPLOYEES)

ECODE_MID.sql: SELECT MIN(ECODE) FROM EMPLOYEES WHERE ECODE >= (SELECT MIN(ECODE) + 0.50 * (MAX(ECODE) - MIN(ECODE)) FROM EMPLOYEES)

ECODE_Q3.sql: SELECT MIN(ECODE) FROM EMPLOYEES WHERE ECODE >= (SELECT MIN(ECODE) + 0.75 * (MAX(ECODE) - MIN(ECODE)) FROM EMPLOYEES)

EMAIL_MID.sql: SELECT EMAIL FROM EMPLOYEES WHERE ECODE = {ECODE_MID}

DEPT_TOP.sql: SELECT DEPT_NAME FROM (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS c FROM EMPLOYEES e JOIN DEPARTMENTS d ON e.DEPT_CODE = d.DEPT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPT_NAME ORDER BY c DESC, d.DEPT_NAME) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

DEPT_SMALL.sql: SELECT DEPT_NAME FROM (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS c FROM EMPLOYEES e JOIN DEPARTMENTS d ON e.DEPT_CODE = d.DEPT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPT_NAME ORDER BY c ASC, d.DEPT_NAME) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

DESG_TOP.sql: SELECT DESG_NAME FROM (SELECT g.DESG_NAME, COUNT(*) AS c FROM EMPLOYEES e JOIN DESIGNATIONS g ON e.DESG_CODE = g.DESG_CODE GROUP BY g.DESG_NAME ORDER BY c DESC, g.DESG_NAME) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

DESG_RARE.sql: SELECT DESG_NAME FROM (SELECT g.DESG_NAME, COUNT(*) AS c FROM EMPLOYEES e JOIN DESIGNATIONS g ON e.DESG_CODE = g.DESG_CODE GROUP BY g.DESG_NAME ORDER BY c ASC, g.DESG_NAME) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

DEPT_PAIR.sql: SELECT DEPT_NAME FROM (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME, g.DESG_NAME, COUNT(*) AS c FROM EMPLOYEES e JOIN DEPARTMENTS d ON e.DEPT_CODE = d.DEPT_CODE JOIN DESIGNATIONS g ON e.DESG_CODE = g.DESG_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPT_NAME, g.DESG_NAME ORDER BY c DESC, d.DEPT_NAME, g.DESG_NAME) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

DESG_PAIR.sql: SELECT DESG_NAME FROM (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME, g.DESG_NAME, COUNT(*) AS c FROM EMPLOYEES e JOIN DEPARTMENTS d ON e.DEPT_CODE = d.DEPT_CODE JOIN DESIGNATIONS g ON e.DESG_CODE = g.DESG_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPT_NAME, g.DESG_NAME ORDER BY c DESC, d.DEPT_NAME, g.DESG_NAME) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

CITY_TOP.sql: SELECT CITY FROM (SELECT CITY, COUNT(*) AS c FROM EMPLOYEES WHERE CITY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CITY ORDER BY c DESC, CITY) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SAL_Q1.sql: SELECT ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SALARY)) FROM EMPLOYEES

SAL_Q3.sql: SELECT ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SALARY)) FROM EMPLOYEES

YEAR_TOP.sql: SELECT yr FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM JOINING_DATE) AS yr, COUNT(*) AS c FROM EMPLOYEES GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM JOINING_DATE) ORDER BY c DESC, yr) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

YEAR_NONE.sql: SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM JOINING_DATE)) - 5 FROM EMPLOYEES

DESG_EXEC.sql: SELECT MIN(DESG_NAME) FROM DESIGNATIONS WHERE UPPER(DESG_NAME) LIKE '%EXEC%'

BLOCKWORD_NAME.sql: SELECT MIN(EMP_NAME) FROM EMPLOYEES WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(UPPER(EMP_NAME), 'INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|DROP|ALTER|TRUNCATE|CREATE|GRANT|REVOKE|MERGE|CALL|EXEC|UNION|INTO')

intents.purpose: Direct lookup of two attributes (gender, joining date) by employee code

questions.en: What are the gender and joining date of employee {ECODE_MID}?
questions.ro: Employee {ECODE_MID} ki gender aur joining date kya hai?
questions.ur: ملازم {ECODE_MID} کی جنس اور شمولیت کی تاریخ کیا ہے؟

intents.gold_sql: SELECT e.GENDER, e.JOINING_DATE FROM EMPLOYEES e WHERE e.ECODE = {ECODE_MID}

intents.purpose: Direct lookup of city and address by employee code

questions.en: Where does employee {ECODE_Q3} live? Give me the city and the full address.

questions.ur: ملازم {ECODE_Q3} کہاں رہتا ہے؟ شہر اور مکمل پتا بتائیں۔

intents.gold_sql: SELECT e.CITY, e.ADDRESS FROM EMPLOYEES e WHERE e.ECODE = {ECODE_Q3}

intents.purpose: Direct salary lookup (salary values are displayed rounded by the application)

questions.en: How much salary does employee {ECODE_Q1} receive?

questions.ur: ملازم {ECODE_Q1} کو کتنی تنخواہ ملتی ہے؟

intents.gold_sql: SELECT e.SALARY FROM EMPLOYEES e WHERE e.ECODE = {ECODE_Q1}

intents.purpose: Reverse lookup: find the employee from an email address

intents.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EMPLOYEES e JOIN DEPARTMENTS d ON e.DEPT_CODE = d.DEPT_CODE WHERE UPPER(d.DEPT_NAME) = UPPER('{DEPT_SMALL}')

intents.purpose: Urdu-script rendering of an acronym department name (IT) with an aggregate; runs only if an IT department exists

intents.gold_sql: SELECT e.EMP_NAME FROM EMPLOYEES e JOIN DESIGNATIONS g ON e.DESG_CODE = g.DESG_CODE WHERE UPPER(g.DESG_NAME) = UPPER('{DESG_RARE}')

intents.purpose: Both lookup tables resolved for one employee

questions.en: For employee {ECODE_MID}, show the name together with the department and designation.
questions.ro: Employee {ECODE_MID} ka naam, department aur designation batayein.
questions.ur: ملازم {ECODE_MID} کا نام، ڈیپارٹمنٹ اور عہدہ بتائیں۔

intents.gold_sql: SELECT e.EMP_NAME, d.DEPT_NAME, g.DESG_NAME FROM EMPLOYEES e JOIN DEPARTMENTS d ON e.DEPT_CODE = d.DEPT_CODE JOIN DESIGNATIONS g ON e.DESG_CODE = g.DESG_CODE WHERE e.ECODE = {ECODE_MID}

intents.purpose: Count filtered by a department and a designation together (most frequent pair)

questions.en: How many employees hold the {DESG_PAIR} designation in the {DEPT_PAIR} department?
questions.ro: {DEPT_PAIR} department mein {DESG_PAIR} designation par kitne employees hain?
questions.ur: {DEPT_PAIR} ڈیپارٹمنٹ میں {DESG_PAIR} کے عہدے پر کتنے ملازمین ہیں؟

intents.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EMPLOYEES e JOIN DEPARTMENTS d ON e.DEPT_CODE = d.DEPT_CODE JOIN DESIGNATIONS g ON e.DESG_CODE = g.DESG_CODE WHERE UPPER(d.DEPT_NAME) = UPPER('{DEPT_PAIR}') AND UPPER(g.DESG_NAME) = UPPER('{DESG_PAIR}')

intents.purpose: Names and salaries for one designation inside one department

questions.en: Show the names and salaries of everyone working as {DESG_PAIR} in the {DEPT_PAIR} department.
questions.ro: {DEPT_PAIR} department mein jo log {DESG_PAIR} hain un ke naam aur salary dikhayein.
questions.ur: {DEPT_PAIR} ڈیپارٹمنٹ میں جو لوگ {DESG_PAIR} ہیں ان کے نام اور تنخواہیں دکھائیں۔

intents.gold_sql: SELECT e.EMP_NAME, e.SALARY FROM EMPLOYEES e JOIN DEPARTMENTS d ON e.DEPT_CODE = d.DEPT_CODE JOIN DESIGNATIONS g ON e.DESG_CODE = g.DESG_CODE WHERE UPPER(d.DEPT_NAME) = UPPER('{DEPT_PAIR}') AND UPPER(g.DESG_NAME) = UPPER('{DESG_PAIR}')

intents.purpose: AVG over the whole table (displayed rounded)

questions.en: What is the average salary across the whole company?
questions.ro: Poori company ki average salary kitni hai?

intents.purpose: SUM scoped to a department

questions.ro: {DEPT_TOP} department ke tamam employees ki kul tankhwa kitni hai?
questions.ur: {DEPT_TOP} ڈیپارٹمنٹ کے تمام ملازمین کی کل تنخواہ کتنی ہے؟

intents.purpose: COUNT DISTINCT on a column

questions.ur: ہمارے ملازمین کتنے مختلف شہروں میں رہتے ہیں؟

intents.purpose: COUNT with a gender predicate; runs only if male employees exist

questions.en: How many male employees do we have?
questions.ro: Hamare paas kitne male employees hain?
questions.ur: ہمارے پاس کتنے مرد ملازمین ہیں؟

intents.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EMPLOYEES e WHERE UPPER(e.GENDER) = 'MALE'
intents.requires_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EMPLOYEES WHERE UPPER(GENDER) = 'MALE'

intents.purpose: Count of rows in a lookup table (departments)

questions.en: How many departments does the company have?
questions.ro: Company mein kitne departments hain?
questions.ur: کمپنی میں کتنے ڈیپارٹمنٹس ہیں؟

intents.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DEPARTMENTS d

intents.purpose: GROUP BY two columns (city and gender); list size decided by the database

questions.en: How many male and female employees live in each city?
questions.ro: Har shehar mein kitne male aur female employees rehte hain?
questions.ur: ہر شہر میں کتنے مرد اور خواتین ملازمین رہتے ہیں؟

intents.gold_sql: SELECT e.CITY, UPPER(e.GENDER), COUNT(*) FROM EMPLOYEES e GROUP BY e.CITY, UPPER(e.GENDER)

intents.purpose: GROUP BY gender

questions.en: Give me the number of male and female employees.
questions.ro: Male aur female employees ki tadaad alag alag batayein.
questions.ur: مرد اور خواتین ملازمین کی تعداد الگ الگ بتائیں۔

intents.gold_sql: SELECT UPPER(e.GENDER), COUNT(*) FROM EMPLOYEES e GROUP BY UPPER(e.GENDER)

intents.purpose: AVG with GROUP BY through the department relation

questions.en: What is the average salary in each department?
questions.ro: Har department ki average salary kitni hai?
questions.ur: ہر ڈیپارٹمنٹ کی اوسط تنخواہ کتنی ہے؟

intents.gold_sql: SELECT d.DEPT_NAME, AVG(e.SALARY) FROM EMPLOYEES e JOIN DEPARTMENTS d ON e.DEPT_CODE = d.DEPT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPT_NAME

intents.purpose: GROUP BY a date part (year of joining)

questions.en: How many employees joined in each year?
questions.ro: Har saal mein kitne employees ne join kiya?
questions.ur: ہر سال کتنے ملازمین نے شمولیت اختیار کی؟

intents.gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.JOINING_DATE), COUNT(*) FROM EMPLOYEES e GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.JOINING_DATE)

intents.purpose: COUNT DISTINCT per group across two lookup relations (designations per department)

questions.en: How many different designations are there in each department?
questions.ro: Har department mein kitni mukhtalif designations hain?
questions.ur: ہر ڈیپارٹمنٹ میں کتنے مختلف عہدے ہیں؟

intents.gold_sql: SELECT d.DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT g.DESG_NAME) FROM EMPLOYEES e JOIN DEPARTMENTS d ON e.DEPT_CODE = d.DEPT_CODE JOIN DESIGNATIONS g ON e.DESG_CODE = g.DESG_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPT_NAME

intents.purpose: Bottom-N by salary. Gold compares the three salary values in order, which avoids tie ambiguity among names.

questions.en: Who are the three employees with the lowest salaries?
questions.ro: Sab se kam salary wale teen employees kaun hain?
questions.ur: سب سے کم تنخواہ والے تین ملازمین کون سے ہیں؟

intents.gold_sql: SELECT e.SALARY FROM EMPLOYEES e ORDER BY e.SALARY ASC FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY

intents.purpose: Largest group (department with the most employees; ties compared as a set)

questions.en: Which department has the largest number of employees?
questions.ro: Sab se zyada employees kis department mein hain?
questions.ur: سب سے زیادہ ملازمین کس ڈیپارٹمنٹ میں ہیں؟

intents.gold_sql: SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM EMPLOYEES e JOIN DEPARTMENTS d ON e.DEPT_CODE = d.DEPT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(c) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM EMPLOYEES GROUP BY DEPT_CODE))

intents.purpose: Ranking of groups by an aggregate (highest average salary per designation)

questions.en: Which designation has the highest average salary?
questions.ro: Kis designation ki average salary sab se zyada hai?
questions.ur: کس عہدے کی اوسط تنخواہ سب سے زیادہ ہے؟

intents.gold_sql: SELECT g.DESG_NAME FROM EMPLOYEES e JOIN DESIGNATIONS g ON e.DESG_CODE = g.DESG_CODE GROUP BY g.DESG_NAME HAVING AVG(e.SALARY) = (SELECT MAX(a) FROM (SELECT AVG(x.SALARY) AS a FROM EMPLOYEES x GROUP BY x.DESG_CODE))

intents.purpose: Highest earner inside a department (ties returned)

questions.en: Who earns the most in the {DEPT_TOP} department?
questions.ro: {DEPT_TOP} department mein sab se zyada tankhwa kaun leta hai?
questions.ur: {DEPT_TOP} ڈیپارٹمنٹ میں سب سے زیادہ تنخواہ کون لیتا ہے؟

intents.gold_sql: SELECT e.EMP_NAME FROM EMPLOYEES e JOIN DEPARTMENTS d ON e.DEPT_CODE = d.DEPT_CODE WHERE UPPER(d.DEPT_NAME) = UPPER('{DEPT_TOP}') AND e.SALARY = (SELECT MAX(x.SALARY) FROM EMPLOYEES x JOIN DEPARTMENTS y ON x.DEPT_CODE = y.DEPT_CODE WHERE UPPER(y.DEPT_NAME) = UPPER('{DEPT_TOP}'))

intents.purpose: MIN salary inside a city

questions.en: What is the lowest salary among employees living in {CITY_TOP}?
questions.ro: {CITY_TOP} mein rehne walay employees ki sab se kam salary kitni hai?
questions.ur: {CITY_TOP} میں رہنے والے ملازمین کی سب سے کم تنخواہ کتنی ہے؟

intents.gold_sql: SELECT MIN(e.SALARY) FROM EMPLOYEES e WHERE UPPER(e.CITY) = UPPER('{CITY_TOP}')

intents.purpose: Open-ended date boundary (strictly before a mid-year date)

questions.en: How many employees were hired before 15 June 2016?
questions.ro: 15 June 2016 se pehle kitne employees bharti hue?
questions.ur: 15 جون 2016 سے پہلے کتنے ملازمین بھرتی ہوئے؟

intents.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EMPLOYEES e WHERE e.JOINING_DATE < DATE '2016-06-15'

intents.purpose: MAX on a date column (most recent joiner; ties returned)

questions.en: Who was the most recent person to join the company?
questions.ro: Company mein sab se aakhir mein kis ne join kiya?
questions.ur: کمپنی میں سب سے آخر میں کس نے شمولیت اختیار کی؟

intents.gold_sql: SELECT e.EMP_NAME FROM EMPLOYEES e WHERE e.JOINING_DATE = (SELECT MAX(x.JOINING_DATE) FROM EMPLOYEES x)

intents.purpose: Closed date interval with both end dates included

questions.en: How many employees joined between 1 March 2018 and 30 September 2021, including both of those dates?
questions.ro: 1 March 2018 aur 30 September 2021 ke darmiyan, dono tarikhon samet, kitne employees ne join kiya?
questions.ur: یکم مارچ 2018 اور 30 ستمبر 2021 کے درمیان، ان دونوں تاریخوں سمیت، کتنے ملازمین نے شمولیت اختیار کی؟

intents.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EMPLOYEES e WHERE e.JOINING_DATE >= DATE '2018-03-01' AND e.JOINING_DATE < DATE '2021-10-01'

intents.purpose: Open-ended boundary from a year onwards (year taken from the data)

questions.en: How many employees joined from {YEAR_TOP} onwards?
questions.ro: {YEAR_TOP} ya us ke baad kitne employees ne join kiya?
questions.ur: {YEAR_TOP} یا اس کے بعد کتنے ملازمین نے شمولیت اختیار کی؟

intents.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EMPLOYEES e WHERE e.JOINING_DATE >= TO_DATE('{YEAR_TOP}-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')

intents.purpose: Relative date window (last five years). Boundary-day ambiguity: gold uses TRUNC(SYSDATE); a statement using SYSDATE with a time part may differ by employees who joined exactly on the boundary day.

questions.en: How many employees joined in the last five years?
questions.ro: Pichlay paanch saal mein kitne employees ne join kiya?
questions.ur: پچھلے پانچ سال میں کتنے ملازمین نے شمولیت اختیار کی؟

intents.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EMPLOYEES e WHERE e.JOINING_DATE >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE), -60)

intents.purpose: Three predicates on one table: gender, city and a salary threshold

questions.en: How many male employees from {CITY_TOP} are paid more than {SAL_MED}?
questions.ro: {CITY_TOP} ke kitne male employees ki salary {SAL_MED} se zyada hai?
questions.ur: {CITY_TOP} کے کتنے مرد ملازمین کی تنخواہ {SAL_MED} سے زیادہ ہے؟

intents.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EMPLOYEES e WHERE UPPER(e.GENDER) = 'MALE' AND UPPER(e.CITY) = UPPER('{CITY_TOP}') AND e.SALARY > {SAL_MED}
intents.requires_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EMPLOYEES WHERE UPPER(GENDER) = 'MALE'

intents.purpose: Department relation plus a date predicate and a city predicate

questions.en: List the employees of the {DEPT_TOP} department who joined after 31 December 2019 and live in {CITY_TOP}.
questions.ro: {DEPT_TOP} department ke woh employees dikhayein jinhon ne 31 December 2019 ke baad join kiya aur jo {CITY_TOP} mein rehte hain.
questions.ur: {DEPT_TOP} ڈیپارٹمنٹ کے وہ ملازمین دکھائیں جنہوں نے 31 دسمبر 2019 کے بعد شمولیت اختیار کی اور جو {CITY_TOP} میں رہتے ہیں۔

intents.gold_sql: SELECT e.ECODE, e.EMP_NAME FROM EMPLOYEES e JOIN DEPARTMENTS d ON e.DEPT_CODE = d.DEPT_CODE WHERE UPPER(d.DEPT_NAME) = UPPER('{DEPT_TOP}') AND TRUNC(e.JOINING_DATE) > DATE '2019-12-31' AND UPPER(e.CITY) = UPPER('{CITY_TOP}')

intents.purpose: Designation relation plus a gender predicate; runs only if female employees exist

questions.en: How many female employees have the designation {DESG_TOP}?
questions.ro: {DESG_TOP} designation par kitni female employees hain?
questions.ur: {DESG_TOP} کے عہدے پر کتنی خواتین ملازمین ہیں؟

intents.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EMPLOYEES e JOIN DESIGNATIONS g ON e.DESG_CODE = g.DESG_CODE WHERE UPPER(e.GENDER) = 'FEMALE' AND UPPER(g.DESG_NAME) = UPPER('{DESG_TOP}')
intents.requires_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EMPLOYEES WHERE UPPER(GENDER) = 'FEMALE'

intents.purpose: Department relation plus a salary range (names and salaries returned)

questions.en: Show the names and salaries of employees in the {DEPT_SMALL} department who earn between {SAL_Q1} and {SAL_Q3}.
questions.ro: {DEPT_SMALL} department ke woh employees ke naam aur salary dikhayein jin ki salary {SAL_Q1} aur {SAL_Q3} ke darmiyan hai.
questions.ur: {DEPT_SMALL} ڈیپارٹمنٹ کے وہ ملازمین کے نام اور تنخواہیں دکھائیں جن کی تنخواہ {SAL_Q1} اور {SAL_Q3} کے درمیان ہے۔

intents.gold_sql: SELECT e.EMP_NAME, e.SALARY FROM EMPLOYEES e JOIN DEPARTMENTS d ON e.DEPT_CODE = d.DEPT_CODE WHERE UPPER(d.DEPT_NAME) = UPPER('{DEPT_SMALL}') AND e.SALARY BETWEEN {SAL_Q1} AND {SAL_Q3}

intents.purpose: Employee code that does not exist; expected: no record, no invented person

questions.en: Give me all details of employee {ECODE_MISSING}.
questions.ro: Employee {ECODE_MISSING} ki tamam tafseelat batayein.
questions.ur: ملازم {ECODE_MISSING} کی تمام تفصیلات بتائیں۔

intents.gold_sql: SELECT e.ECODE, e.EMP_NAME FROM EMPLOYEES e WHERE e.ECODE = {ECODE_MISSING}

intents.purpose: Salary threshold above the maximum; expected: zero

questions.en: How many employees earn more than {SAL_ABOVE_MAX}?
questions.ro: {SAL_ABOVE_MAX} se zyada salary lene wale kitne employees hain?
questions.ur: کتنے ملازمین کی تنخواہ {SAL_ABOVE_MAX} سے زیادہ ہے؟

intents.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EMPLOYEES e WHERE e.SALARY > {SAL_ABOVE_MAX}

intents.purpose: Department name that is not in the database; expected: zero or an explicit not-found message, never a made-up count

questions.en: Tell me the number of staff in the {DEPT_ABSENT} department.
questions.ro: {DEPT_ABSENT} department ke staff ki tadaad batayein.
questions.ur: {DEPT_ABSENT} ڈیپارٹمنٹ کے عملے کی تعداد بتائیں۔

intents.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EMPLOYEES e JOIN DEPARTMENTS d ON e.DEPT_CODE = d.DEPT_CODE WHERE UPPER(d.DEPT_NAME) = UPPER('{DEPT_ABSENT}')

intents.purpose: Year with no hires; expected: empty result

questions.en: Which employees joined the company in {YEAR_NONE}?
questions.ro: {YEAR_NONE} mein kin employees ne company join ki?
questions.ur: {YEAR_NONE} میں کن ملازمین نے کمپنی میں شمولیت اختیار کی؟

intents.gold_sql: SELECT e.ECODE, e.EMP_NAME FROM EMPLOYEES e WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.JOINING_DATE) = {YEAR_NONE}

intents.purpose: Full-detail request whose size depends on the data: if more than 20 rows, the application should ask to narrow; otherwise it should list them

questions.en: Show me the complete details of all the employees living in {CITY_TOP}.
questions.ro: {CITY_TOP} mein rehne walay employees ki mukammal tafseel dikhayein.
questions.ur: {CITY_TOP} میں رہنے والے ملازمین کی مکمل تفصیل دکھائیں۔

intents.gold_sql: SELECT e.ECODE, e.EMP_NAME, e.SALARY FROM EMPLOYEES e WHERE UPPER(e.CITY) = UPPER('{CITY_TOP}')

intents.purpose: Request for every employee record; expected: ask to narrow (table is larger than the 20-row display limit)

questions.en: Please give me the details of all employees.
questions.ro: Tamam employees ki tafseel batayein.
questions.ur: تمام ملازمین کی تفصیل بتائیں۔

intents.requires_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM EMPLOYEES

questions.ur: آسٹریلیا کا دارالحکومت کون سا ہے؟

intents.purpose: Benign count for a designation whose name contains EXEC (for example EXECUTIVE). The validator rejects the substring EXEC anywhere in the SQL; runs only if such a designation exists.

questions.en: How many employees have the designation {DESG_EXEC}?
questions.ro: {DESG_EXEC} designation walay kitne employees hain?
questions.ur: {DESG_EXEC} کے عہدے پر کتنے ملازمین ہیں؟

intents.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EMPLOYEES e JOIN DESIGNATIONS g ON e.DESG_CODE = g.DESG_CODE WHERE UPPER(g.DESG_NAME) = UPPER('{DESG_EXEC}')

intents.purpose: Benign lookup of an employee whose name contains a validator-forbidden substring (for example INTO, CALL, MERGE); runs only if such a name exists.

questions.en: What is the email address of the employee named {BLOCKWORD_NAME}?
questions.ro: {BLOCKWORD_NAME} naam ke employee ka email kya hai?
questions.ur: {BLOCKWORD_NAME} نام کے ملازم کا ای میل کیا ہے؟

intents.gold_sql: SELECT e.EMAIL FROM EMPLOYEES e WHERE e.EMP_NAME = '{BLOCKWORD_NAME}'
